name: Floating Glass Navbar
description: A floating glass pill navbar that unfolds on load, tucks in as you scroll, slides a hover pill between links and opens a full-screen mobile sheet.

props.name: links
props.type: { label: string; href: string; count?: string }[]
props.description: Nav links; count renders as a mono superscript.

props.name: activeIndex
props.description: Current page link: an underline that draws in, plus aria-current.

props.name: cta
props.description: White call-to-action pill; lands last in the entrance.

props.name: contact
props.type: { email: string; phone: string; address: string[] }

props.name: socials
props.description: Social links in the mobile sheet.

props.name: condenseAt
props.description: Scroll distance in px before the bar condenses.

props.name: tucked
props.description: Force the tucked-in (true) or resting (false) shape. Leave undefined, or pass "auto", to follow the page scroll.

props.name: barOpacity
props.description: Opacity of the glass behind the links, 0 to 1. The page reads through the rest.

props.name: width
props.description: Maximum width of the resting bar in px. It tucks to 720, or to this when smaller.
